chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 186: Ji Ning Earns His Master’s Approval & a Deadly Gift
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning finally masters the second stance of the Three-Foot Sword, earning the Diancai Immortal's permission to leave the Black-White College and explore the vast world with a parting gift of two legendary treasures.
og_title: Ji Ning Gets His Walking Papers and a God-Tier Care Package
og_description: The training arc is over! Ji Ning's master finally lets him leave after a brutal three-year run, but not without handing over the ultimate 'break glass in case of death' items.
